role: Task-local switch selecting the language/locale narrative builders (summaries, causes, score details, readiness) write in; english{} forces English for machine consumers like the assistant context. Also number formatting helpers.
types: NarrativeLanguage: enum — task-local language selection and formatting helpers
toplevel: englishBundle is a lazily-initialized static: Bundle at main bundle's en.lproj path, falling back to Bundle.main when that lproj is absent.

units.does: Returns englishBundle when isEnglish task-local is true, else LanguageManager.appBundle.
units.contract: Returns the English bundle while the isEnglish task-local is true, otherwise the app-language bundle (LanguageManager.appBundle).

units.does: Returns en_US_POSIX locale when isEnglish, else LanguageManager.appLocale.
Runs body synchronously with the isEnglish task-local bound to true and returns its result (rethrows).
Formats a Double with fixed fraction digits, no grouping, in the narrative locale.
units.contract: Returns value formatted with exactly decimals fraction digits (default 0), without grouping separators, in the narrative locale.

units.does: Formats an Int with no grouping in the narrative locale.
units.contract: Returns the integer formatted with no grouping separators in the narrative locale.

units.does: Formats a Double with fixed fraction digits, always-shown sign, no grouping, in the narrative locale.
English mode: '<h>h <m>m' for >=60 minutes else '<m>m'; otherwise LocalizedDuration.hoursMinutes in the app language.

branches.effect: false (English): returns hand-built string; true: returns LocalizedDuration.hoursMinutes
true: 'Xh Ym'; false: 'Ym' (negative minutes yield e.g. '-5m'; LocalizedDuration clamps negatives to 0)
